String.string:
[EN] Every Child Is Our Child
[ES] Cada Niño Es Nuestro Niño
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] We must save our eggs from the predations of the argons!
[ES] ¡Debemos salvar nuestros huevos de las depredaciones de los argones!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] This gift of life is beyond price. Thank you.
[ES] Este regalo de vida no tiene precio. Gracias.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill Kezelran so you can recover the eggs without alerting the argons.
[ES] Mata a Kezelran para que puedas recuperar los huevos sin alertar a los argones.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Honored to be of service."
[ES] "Honrado de ser de utilidad."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Rescue the sikandari eggs from the Hatchery.
[ES] Rescata los huevos de sikandari del Criadero.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Bring the sikandari eggs to Qrawkil at Accipiter Watchpost.
[ES] Lleva los huevos de sikandari a Qrawkil en el Puesto de Vigía de Accipiter.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
